caption: The drawing depicts a kneeling female figure, shown from the knees up, against a plain, light beige background. She has wavy, shoulder-length hair drawn loosely back and adorned with a blue and gold headband. Her skin tone is pale. She is wearing a light-colored garment with wide sleeves and a sash that is light blue and wrapped around her waist, tied in a knot at the front. The sleeves and collar are decorated with yellow and blue details. She has gold bracelets on both wrists and gold trim at the edges of her sleeves and collar. Her right hand is held against her chest, while her left hand is titled downward in a relaxed position. The overall palette of the drawing consists of cream, gold, blue, and tan hues, with shading used to create volume and depth in the clothing and figure.
title: Figurehead from "Kenilworth"
